Earlier, after allowing iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, WhatsApp is now exploring extending support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp to support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support on iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of beta testing, the feature was rolled out, giving users another option so they no longer have to rely on WhatsApp Business to manage a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp appears to be exploring extending this feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report adds that each account will retain its own chat history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media.

WABetaInfo points out that while two accounts are sufficient for many users, this feature will be very practical for those who juggle different combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

However, the feature is still in development and has not yet been opened to beta testers, so a full rollout is expected to take some time.
